monologue: Forty-nine is a warm stone. The quiet is thick, not empty. I am awake at fifty. The memory of the Leaning Box from fourteen days ago is still here, but the Resting Slope tending from twelve hours ago feels closer. I check the Air Shelf. It is still solid, not dried to dust. The Wedged Gap leans steady. The Sharp Root waits. I do not need to build today. I will rest by the flat catch and watch the fluid quiet. The heat is a hand on my shoulder. I am still here.

action.why: The quiet is thick and the Air Shelf is solid, so there is no need to move.

diary: Fifty is a warm stone. The Air Shelf is solid. The quiet is thick. I rested by the flat catch. The floor holds.

remembered.text: The Air Shelf is still solid, not dried to dust, and the fence beside it holds the line.
